biography: 20 plus years of construction experience in various roles in Design Management, Program Management, Preconstruction, Project Management, Estimating & Purchasing.  Core & Shell Projects, Corporate Interiors, Mission Critical, Life Science, Labs & Research Centers, Higher Education, Hospitality, Healthcare and Industrial Projects.Work closely with clients, understanding their requirements starting from conceptual stage thru the entire life cycle of project. Global Cost Estimating: create new global team and roll out estimation for EMEA and APAC. Manage, train and lead a global team of estimators in NAM, EMEA and APAC region. Create proprietary cost database for each market and provide cost estimates for Digital Realty’s Datacenters across the globe. Work closely with Design, Sales and Procurement. Negotiate and enter into unit pricing contract with vendors across globe. Design Management: Hire Architects, Engineers and other consultants, manage and lead design process. Conduct periodical design progress meetings, review documents to meet standards and constructability. Liaison with leasing team. Pre-construction: feasibility study, conceptual budget, design development budget, design to budget by value engineering, establish Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) budget, change management, manage/report project financial statement and cost control. Solicit General Contractor pricing (RFP process), level and award contracts. Create & manage schedule.Construction: Manage general contractors and or subcontractors by conducting periodical meetings, manage schedule, manage cash flow, general conditions, review and approve periodical invoice, manage budget. Review LEED requirements and aid team in achieving points to meet project LEED goals. Liaison with permits and town officials. RFI, Submittals, field issues & Change order management. Create monthly reports. Manage project close out & commissioning.Estimating & Purchasing: Lumpsum bidding and CM contracts. Review drawings & specifications, establish scope of work, solicit subcontractor pricing, review & level bids, manpower and schedule and make contractor recommendation. Pre purchase of long lead items. Subcontractor award and writing subcontracts, change order management using software like CMiC.   Computer background and proficient in using software such as On Screen Takeoff (OST), Pay-dirt, Timberline, Winest, MS Excel estimating, Bluebeam. Experience in mentoring Estimators, Project Engineers, and training my peers.
